description: What one connected TikTok account allows, read from TikTok now: the visibility levels TikTok offers it (before TikTok’s audit, only Only me), whether the account has comments, duets or stitches switched off, and the longest video it may post. Use it to draft sensibly (a video under the limit) and to explain the choices the owner will make. Read only: who can see a TikTok post and how people may interact with it are chosen by the owner on the TikTok screen, never by you or the API (TikTok’s content sharing guidelines). Changes nothing.

accountId.description: A connected TikTok account id from accounts_list.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).
